cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(wifi-tls)

# Sparkplug B protobuf, generated by nanopb into the build directory (proto/sparkplug_b.pb.h).
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${ZEPHYR_BASE}/modules/nanopb)
include(nanopb)
zephyr_nanopb_sources(app proto/sparkplug_b.proto)

target_sources(app PRIVATE
	src/main.c
	src/modbus_reader.c
	src/mqtt_transport.c
	src/sparkplug_node.c
	src/sparkplug_payload.c
)
target_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_NETWORK_CELLULAR app PRIVATE src/network_modem.c)
target_sources_ifndef(CONFIG_NETWORK_CELLULAR app PRIVATE src/network_wifi.c)
